description: Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Contacts over their APIs, for the gmail, google-calendar and google-contacts apps: it reaches only Google, with the access tokens each run gets.

tools.name: mail-sync
tools.description: What changed in each account's Gmail since the last run (an import, a page at a time, then its history).

tools.name: mail-modify
tools.description: Adds and removes labels on a thread (input: account, thread, add, remove).

tools.name: mail-send
tools.description: Sends a message (input: account, raw, thread).

tools.name: mail-draft
tools.description: Saves a draft (input: account, raw, thread, draft_id).

tools.name: calendar-sync
tools.description: What changed in each account's calendars.

tools.name: calendar-write
tools.description: Creates, changes, deletes or answers an event (input: action, edit).

tools.name: contacts-sync
tools.description: What changed in each account's contacts.

tools.name: contacts-write
tools.description: Adds a contact in the carbon6 group (input: account, name, email).
